name: aero-hand-open
readme_summary: Aero Hand Open is an open-source, tendon-driven robotic hand designed for dexterous manipulation research. It emphasizes simplicity, reliability, and affordability, utilizing 3D printing and off-the-shelf components for accessibility.
key_features: 7 DoFs robotic hand with 5 fingers (16 joints)
Fully 3D-printed structure, modular and easy to assemble
Independent Python SDK, compatible with ESP32 and ROS2
primary_use_case: Dexterous manipulation research and development for educational institutions, research labs, and robotics enthusiasts.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled artisan, resembling a robotic arm, meticulously assembling a delicate, intricate mechanical flower using 3D-printed components and fine wires (tendons). The flower's petals unfurl gracefully, symbolizing dexterity and precision. Subtle glowing lines of code emanate from the artisan's base, connecting to a small, transparent screen displaying a simplified schematic of the robotic hand. The scene is set in a bright, clean workshop with a soft, focused light, highlighting the creation process. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, modern aesthetic, emphasizing the blend of hardware and software in creating an accessible manipulation tool.

name: memora
description: Give your AI agents persistent memory.
readme_summary: Memora provides AI agents with persistent memory capabilities, enabling structured storage, semantic retrieval, and graph-based relationships between memories. It allows agents to absorb information, recall relevant details, and maintain context across sessions, enhancing their functionality and intelligence.
primary_use_case: To provide AI agents with a robust and persistent memory system that allows for structured storage, intelligent retrieval, and contextual understanding across multiple interactions and sessions.
cover_image_prompt: A wise old librarian meticulously organizing glowing, interconnected memory orbs within a vast, ethereal library. Each orb represents a piece of information or an agent's experience, linked by luminous threads. The librarian uses a digital quill to add new orbs or draw connections, with subtle holographic interfaces displaying semantic relationships and data streams. In the background, a faint outline of a digital agent can be seen interacting with the library. The scene is bathed in a soft, intellectual glow, emphasizing knowledge and interconnectedness. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, futuristic aesthetic, focusing on the metaphor of a structured, searchable, and interconnected memory archive for AI.

name: uniface
description: UniFace: A Unified Face Analysis Library for Python | Detection, alignment, landmarks, recognition, parsing, gaze, attributes and anti-spoofing under one API.
readme_summary: UniFace is a comprehensive Python library for face analysis, offering a unified API for tasks like detection, recognition, landmark analysis, parsing, gaze estimation, and attribute analysis. It supports multiple state-of-the-art models and provides hardware acceleration for efficient processing.
key_features: Facial Landmarks (106-point, PIPNet, MediaPipe Face Mesh)
Attribute Analysis (Age, Gender, Emotion, Face States)
primary_use_case: Performing a wide range of face analysis tasks through a single, unified Python API, supporting various models and hardware accelerations.
cover_image_prompt: A master artisan in a futuristic workshop, holding a magnifying glass over a holographic projection of a human face. The projection displays various intricate details like facial landmarks, emotion indicators, and gaze vectors, all seamlessly integrated. The artisan's hands are surrounded by subtle digital particles representing data streams. Small, unobtrusive screens around the workshop show different facial analysis results like age, gender, and identity matches. The repository name 'UniFace' is subtly etched onto a tool. The scene is illuminated with a soft, technological glow, emphasizing precision and comprehensiveness. Rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with a clean, modern aesthetic and a palette of blues, whites, and subtle golds.

name: lastsignal
description: A self-hosted dead man's switch for delivering encrypted messages (E2EE) to your loved ones — when you're gone or unresponsive.
readme_summary: LastSignal is a self-hosted, open-source dead man's switch that allows users to send encrypted messages to loved ones if they become unresponsive. It operates on an email-first check-in system, ensuring messages are delivered only when the user fails to respond to periodic prompts, with a zero-knowledge architecture for maximum privacy.
key_features: Configurable timing for check-ins and reminders
primary_use_case: To provide a secure, private, and self-hosted method for individuals to ensure important messages are delivered to designated recipients upon their incapacitation or death.
cover_image_prompt: A wise old owl perched on a branch, holding a sealed, glowing envelope in its beak. Below the owl, a digital clock face is slowly ticking down, with some segments already faded. As the clock nears zero, a faint, ethereal pathway of light extends from the owl towards a distant, warm-lit cottage. Subtle digital particles representing encrypted data flow around the owl. The scene is set in a serene, twilight forest, conveying a sense of calm assurance and secure delivery. The repository name 'LastSignal' is subtly etched into the bark of the tree. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with soft lighting and a focus on conveying trust and finality.

name: Profanity-Filtering-All-languages
description: Supports: en en_au en_uk en_us af sq am ar hy as az ba eu be bn bs br bg my ca ceb zh hr cs da nl et fo fi fr gl ka de de_ch el gu ht ha haw he hi hu is ig id it ja jw kn kk km ko ku lo la lv ln lt lb mk mg ms ml mt mi mr mn ne no nn oc pa ps fa pl pt ro ru sa sr sn sd si sk sl so es su sw sv tl tg ta tt te th bo tr tk uk ur uz vi cy yi yo zu
readme_summary: This TypeScript library provides a highly performant profanity filtering solution supporting 107 languages. It offers features like lazy loading, zero runtime dependencies, and a rich API for checking, detecting, and censoring profane content, with options for customization.
key_features: Rich API (check, detect, censor, addWords, removeWords)
primary_use_case: Filtering profanity from text across a wide range of languages in real-time applications.
cover_image_prompt: A vigilant librarian meticulously sorting and cleaning books on a vast, multi-lingual shelf. Each book represents a piece of text. The librarian uses a magical magnifying glass that glows red when it detects offensive words within a book, instantly replacing them with a clean, neutral symbol. Books with clean content are neatly organized and glow with a soft, positive light. Subtle digital particles and small, stylized UI elements representing language flags and censor symbols float around the scene. The overall mood is one of order and digital hygiene. The art style should be a clean, modern 3D isometric illustration with a bright, inviting color palette.

name: frame
readme_summary: Frame is a native desktop application built with Rust that provides a user-friendly graphical interface for FFmpeg operations. It allows users to convert various media types (video, audio, image) with granular control over encoding, processing, and metadata settings, leveraging a reusable Rust core for FFmpeg argument generation and task management.
key_features: Support for video, audio, and image conversion
Granular control over video, audio, and metadata settings
Reusable Rust conversion core for FFmpeg argument generation
Wide range of input and output formats and codecs
primary_use_case: A desktop GUI application for performing media conversions using FFmpeg with advanced control over conversion parameters.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, anthropomorphic robot artisan carefully placing intricate gears and digital streams into a large, ornate clockwork machine. The machine is actively transforming raw, unrefined digital blocks (representing video, audio, and image files) into polished, perfectly shaped media outputs. Subtle UI elements showing sliders and format options are integrated into the robot's workbench. The overall scene is set in a clean, modern workshop with soft, inviting lighting, emphasizing precision and ease of use. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a focus on clear iconography and a vibrant, yet organized color palette. The repository name 'Frame' is subtly etched onto the main machine.
